title: VTC Directory — Fields — Update — payload
description: An administrator changes a directory field's label, help text, constraints, order, ceiling or default visibility, or disables or re-enables a base field. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

constraints.description: Replaces the constraints whole. Values already stored that no longer satisfy them stay until their writer next changes them; projections show them unchanged.

enabled.description: Base fields only: `false` disables the field (hidden from every projection, values kept), `true` re-enables it.

reason.description: Why, recorded with the change and shown to anyone who must approve it.

Response.title: VTC Directory — Fields — Update — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/directory/fields/update/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/directory/fields/update/0.1#response.
